description: USE WHEN you want to understand what one named synthetic regime is, and its nearest historical episodes. Single-regime introspection: median behavioural descriptors, z-scores vs the catalogue (what makes THIS regime distinct), an English characterisation, the 2 nearest neighbours, the nearest real historical episodes and a stylized-facts audit against real history. find_similar_regime ranks neighbours of a target; this says what one regime IS.
